scan.heading: Universe scan
scan.description: Re-runs the full scan: index constituents, discovery screeners, and price history for new names. Slow on free data — minutes, not seconds.

clearData.description: Permanently delete all universe, price, score, portfolio, recommendation, and strategy data for every user. Accounts stay signed in.
clearData.confirm: This permanently deletes ALL app data for ALL users — universe, prices, scores, portfolios, recommendations, strategies. This cannot be undone.
clearData.error: Failed to clear data — check API logs

clearDataAndUsers.description: Permanently delete all application data and every user account. Everyone, including you, will be signed out and must sign up again.
clearDataAndUsers.confirm: This permanently deletes ALL app data AND ALL user accounts, including yours. You will be signed out and need to sign up again. This cannot be undone.
clearDataAndUsers.error: Failed to clear data — check API logs
